blockingFindings.title: implementation-missing-workflow
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Capture and/or implement the documented persona tab model, Home/Messages tabs, custom tabs, pinned surfaces, and minimized/medium/expanded navigation states for each community.

blockingFindings.title: surface-mismatch
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Remediate the UI so each documented card surface is rendered as a visibly distinct product surface with the documented interactions/actions.

blockingFindings.title: visible-proof-gap
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Update product docs if needed, then implement and recapture lifecycle states so the screenshots visibly prove the semantic interaction model.

blockingFindings.title: Primary experience still relies on a repeated stacked-card scaffold
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Create distinct product frames for the highest-volume surfaces: event/calendar, documents, approval/status, marketplace/loan, messages, export/data, payments, and community home. Each frame needs its own layout, hierarchy, content model, and action/result region.

blockingFindings.title: Action-state screenshots are dimmed and do not prove usable after states
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Capture or implement action/result states as normal full-bright product screens with persistent status, history, receipt, or receiver state; avoid relying on dimmed transitional overlays as B25 proof.

blockingFindings.title: Utility/export/ad/social/chess flows still look like status/evidence panels
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Replace utility/status cards with task-specific product surfaces: export wizard with data previews and files, ad-free billing/account settings, social inbox/thread UI, chess board/match UI, and document viewer/link handling.

blockingFindings.title: Persona tabs/navigation and pinned surfaces are not sufficiently visible in committed evidence
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Add screenshot coverage for community home tab, Messages/Communication tab, custom persona tabs, pinned surfaces, and minimized/medium/expanded card states; update UI where the tab model is not visible or not useful.

blockingFindings.title: Workflow lifecycle proof remains incomplete in visible UI
blockingFindings.requiredFix: For each primary workflow, add visible lifecycle controls and state: edit/change/cancel/reject/defer where required, durable result/history/receipt state, and receiver or continuation screens. Recapture after screenshots proving those states.

blockingFindings.title: Workflow lifecycle UX is incomplete
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Use the failed lifecycle scorecards to add concrete objects, decision information, semantic primary and alternate actions, persistent result state, and receiver/continuation state before recapturing evidence.
